events.title: Tech + component
events.description: Added Runai_CrystalNeutrality tech to TechTree.json (researchedAt: TradersHall, cost 200 S + 60 C). New Core/Components/FactionCurseAggroModifier.cs holds the per-faction Reduction value (0.0 baseline, 0.6 cap at L3). ResearchSystem hook to set the component when the tech lands is deferred to Phase 2 since it pairs with locating the curse-wave target picker.

Phase 2 (aggro picker hook) deferred: needs locating the curse-wave target picker in Systems/Creatures/ or Systems/Crystal/, and design alignment on whether the modifier is a flat probability subtract or a multiplicative weight. Depends on task-069 Phase 1 (TradersHall identity) being live for the researchedAt to resolve.
